create_write_checkpoint_decorator: create a write_checkpoint decorator to log function parameters and return values as checkpoints
use_write_checkpoint_on_async_func: use the write_checkpoint decorator on an async function to log checkpoints before and after execution
register_trace_logger_service: register a TraceLoggingService instance with write_checkpoint so decorated functions can write checkpoints
register_run_id_for_checkpoints: register a run_id with write_checkpoint to associate checkpoint data with a specific run
configure_checkpoint_include_params: configure write_checkpoint with include list to selectively dump specific keyword arguments as checkpoint data
